book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Ubuma Ḡezo Roḡaeḡa
Ebu Iesuꞌa Olivi Maḡa onamiro.
Irarirotene, oherebau uzeuze ani kuru neḡa habaꞌa onamiro. Ebu vaze niduꞌa ani vaḡe onamirotene, ani ehoradu ihoziro.
Ebu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu Farisea azaḡaniꞌa ubuma ḡezo roḡaeḡa ꞌahoga obone teadu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa zamao ohone tiro.
Ebu ze Iesu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, roḡae ꞌadaꞌa ubuma ḡezo haḡaeꞌeteꞌe emeḡeꞌa horonadu obone teha.
Mose goro ḡoeꞌano Moseꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, ꞌRoḡae ꞌuguḡaꞌe hadi hina mau runoꞌi.' Ḡaꞌe nouge rae zamareꞌohe?”
Ze ani tuhune nurihi radu ꞌouge rae ḡadimaro, mazaḡa aniꞌa veꞌore naenaezine ani kotao mae ohonihi reiro. Rehano Iesuꞌa ḡuḡuradu ꞌevoꞌa hina rahao mirihiro.
Ze Iesu barebare ḡadinirotene, aniꞌa iḡune edanadu ziro, “Zae boꞌaḡano iniu mazao haḡai sauꞌa oꞌoꞌa vazeḡaniꞌa ibite geno hadi hina ani mau bohinoꞌi.”
Ebu ani bare ḡuḡuradu ꞌevoꞌa hina rahao mirihiro.
Ze Iesu ḡoere igirotene, ze tibatiba iḡune ḡouriro. Vaze boroboroꞌa ibitiro ebu komeꞌakomeꞌaꞌe vesuꞌu iḡuniro. Ebu Iesu ane daꞌo roḡae edauꞌeteꞌe teite eꞌea radiro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa bare iḡune edanadu roḡae eꞌe ḡadiniro, “Roḡae, ze noumao? Ḡaꞌe veꞌoḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡani ꞌahogaꞌe oꞌoꞌahe?”
Aneꞌa naenaeniro, “Vazeni ꞌahoga oꞌoꞌa, vaze boro.” Iesuꞌa niro, “Eḡe zuni ḡaꞌe veꞌoḡa rae mene raꞌohe. Onamoꞌi, ebu izidionoꞌo zama moneo haḡai sauꞌa ago bare haḡaoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌe Raha ꞌAdi Agaḡa
Iesuꞌa bare ḡoeriro, “Eꞌe raha ꞌadi agaḡa. Iniu eḡe hegoteꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe uzabo zamaḡano mene hune ragaviꞌuma, rehano ḡabone hideꞌeteꞌe agaḡa meꞌuma.”
Farisea azaḡaniꞌa niro, “Ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare ḡae moneo rae fureneꞌohe. Aꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa!”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “E eḡeꞌa bare eḡe moneo rae fureneꞌohe, rehano eḡe ḡoereꞌe huga, mazaḡa e noumanoꞌo ariroteꞌe zu noꞌe onamitaꞌaꞌe edeḡa. U zaꞌe eḡeꞌa noumanoꞌo ariroteꞌe zu noꞌe onamitaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa.
Za raha azaḡa zamarone idunaḡano iniuꞌe duduḡa ga veꞌoḡa rae raꞌohe. Rehano e vaze ꞌahoga mazao duduḡa ga veꞌoḡa rae mene raꞌohe.
Rehano eḡeꞌa vaze mazao duduḡa ga veꞌoḡa rae reine zuni, aꞌe duduga, mazaḡa mene eḡe daꞌo, rehano eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe Mamaheꞌa eḡe teite radiuꞌohe.
Zae goro ḡoeꞌano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, 'Vaze aheuꞌe ḡoere tiba reine, aꞌe hube.'
E eḡeꞌa bare eḡe moneo rae fureneꞌohe, ebu eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe Mamahe zuni eḡe moneo rae fureneꞌohe.”
Ebu zeḡeꞌa ḡadiniro, “ꞌOugadu mogoꞌe noumao?” Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Za eḡe zu Mamaꞌe aḡuꞌa. Zaeꞌa eḡe ederifone, eḡe Mama zuni ederifo.”
Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa habaꞌano ḡahunone hadiḡa ufeꞌeteꞌe maḡuḡa uhiḡano ihozeꞌeteꞌea, ḡoere ꞌadi ziro. Rehano ani madaꞌe ꞌize mene feuriro ꞌahine, ze ani mene obone tiro.
Iesuꞌa Ane Rune moneo Ihoziro
Iesuꞌa bare ziro, “Eꞌe oname dauḡiꞌuma, u zaꞌe eḡe vaḡiꞌuma, rehano za haḡaize sauꞌa zamaḡano rudaꞌuma. Ebu eḡeꞌa onamiteꞌe habaꞌaꞌe zaꞌa aroga mene idaḡa.”
Iuda azaḡa boroboroꞌe zeḡeꞌa bare ḡadimutitiro, “Ani aneꞌa bare maꞌumahe? Mazaḡa aniꞌa onamiteꞌe habaꞌaꞌe emeḡeꞌa onamogaꞌe mene idaḡa rae raꞌohe.”
Rehano Iesuꞌa ziro, “Zaꞌe ꞌuꞌuḡanonoꞌo ariro, u eꞌe hitanaonoꞌo ariro. Zaꞌe raha ꞌadi azaḡa, u eꞌe raha ꞌadi mene vazeḡa.
Eꞌanoꞌo e zeha, 'Za haḡaize sauꞌa zamaḡano rudaꞌuma.' Za eḡeꞌa eḡe moneo iniu rae raꞌeteꞌe mene mae ḡihinine, za haḡaize sauꞌa zamaḡano rudaꞌuma.”
Zeḡeꞌa ḡadiniro, “Tena ḡa iniu?” Iesuꞌa ziro, “E ḡadaheḡanonoꞌo eꞌe iniu rae ziꞌohe.
E zae moneo zihi raꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe ḡehaḡa ebu zaꞌe veꞌoḡa raꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa zuni ḡehaḡa. Rehano eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe huga radu e ani mazaonoꞌo igiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa daꞌo raha azaḡa ziꞌohe.”
Rehano ze Iesuꞌa Moga moneo zirotaꞌaꞌe mene ederiro.

Eꞌanoꞌo Iesuꞌa ziro, “Vaze Ubugaꞌe zaeꞌa satauro rana mae ḡihiniteꞌe madaḡano, za eḡeꞌa ziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe rae ederiꞌuma. Ebu e eḡe edeḡano ḡau ꞌahoga mene haḡaeꞌeteꞌe, rehano Mamaꞌa ihohiroteꞌe ḡauḡa daꞌo ḡoereꞌetaꞌaꞌe ederiꞌuma.
Eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe teite radiuꞌohe. Aniꞌe eḡe daꞌo mene mode tauḡiro, mazaḡa e iḡaiḡa aniꞌa matuꞌeꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa daꞌo haḡaeꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa ꞌouge reirotene, vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa ani mazao firo.
Aberahamo Mariga
Ebu Iesuꞌa Iuda azaḡa ani mazao fieꞌeteꞌe ziro, “Za eḡe ihore hegotine, hube hune eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa reꞌuma.
Ebu za ḡoere huga ederiꞌuma. Zaꞌe tuḡure azaḡa teigeꞌohe, rehano ḡoere huga eꞌeꞌa tuḡure azaḡanonoꞌo za bohaze buziꞌuma.”
Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Emeꞌe Aberahamo mariga. Eme vaze ꞌahoga tuḡure azaḡa mene hune reiro. Ḡa nougadu emeꞌe tuḡure azaḡanonoꞌo bohafe bufiꞌuma raꞌohe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniu haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa tuḡure vazeḡa raꞌohe.
Ebu tuḡure vazeḡaꞌe ani teite ne tibano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa teite iḡaiḡa mene radiuꞌohe. U ubugaꞌe ani teite ne tibano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa teite iḡaiḡa radiuꞌohe onamo tuḡutuḡu.
Eꞌanoꞌo Ubuganiꞌa za haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo bohaze buzine, zaꞌe hube hune haḡaize sauꞌanonoꞌo buau radiꞌuma.
E edeḡa, zaꞌe Aberahamo mariga. Rehano eḡe ḡoereꞌe zae zamao oꞌoꞌa uꞌano, za eḡe uḡuhe ruhihi raꞌohe.
E Mamaꞌa ihohiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa ziꞌohe. Rehano zaꞌe moze mazaonoꞌo igiroteꞌe haḡaeꞌohe.”
Zeꞌa naenaeniro, “Aberahamoꞌe emeḡe mama.” Iesuꞌa ziro, “Zaꞌe Aberahamo ubugaubuga reifone, Aberahamoꞌa haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡaifo.
Eꞌe Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo igiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa huga ziro, rehano za e uḡuhe ruhihi raꞌohe. Aberahamoꞌe mene ꞌougiro.
Zaꞌe zae mozeꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa haḡaeꞌohe.” Ebu zeḡeꞌa niro, “Emeꞌe mene butu ega. Badiꞌa ane daꞌoꞌe emeḡe Mama.”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Badiꞌaꞌe Moze reifone, za e zamare borofifo, mazaḡa e Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo aradu izidi ꞌaha radiuꞌohe. E eḡeꞌa bare mene ariro, rehano aniꞌa tuḡuhadu ariro.
Za nougadu eḡeꞌa raꞌeteꞌe ḡoeꞌa mene edereꞌohe? Mazaḡa zaꞌe eḡe ḡoere egoga mene urateꞌohe.

Mozeꞌe Diabolo, ebu zaꞌe moze ura haḡaihi raꞌohe. Aniꞌe ḡadaheḡanonoꞌo vaze maro zu hugano mene haḡaeꞌohe, mazaḡa ani zamaoꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa. Aniꞌa ḡurireꞌetaꞌaꞌe ane haḡai, mazaḡa aniꞌe ḡuriro vazeḡa, zu ḡuriro niduꞌaꞌe ani mazaonoꞌo fureruꞌohe.
Eḡeꞌa ḡoere huga ziꞌe ꞌahine, za eḡe mazao mene fieꞌohe.
Zae boꞌaḡano iniuꞌa eḡe mazao sauꞌa ꞌahoga horonadu eꞌe veꞌoḡa rae reꞌuma? E ḡoere huga raꞌohe, rehano nougadu zaꞌe eḡe mazao mene fieꞌohe?
Iniu Badiꞌa mone vazeḡaꞌe Badiꞌa ḡoere igiꞌohe. Zaꞌe Badiꞌa ḡoere mene igiꞌohe, mazaḡa zaꞌe Badiꞌa mene mone azaḡa.”
Iesu zu Aberahamo
Ebu Iuda azaḡa boroboroꞌa Iesu naenaeniro, “Ḡa Samaria vazeḡa teige veꞌore ḡoereꞌohe, zu vine sauꞌaniꞌa ḡae ragano reiro. Emeḡe ḡoere ꞌahiꞌe mene duduḡahe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “E mene vine sauꞌaheta, rehano Mamahe gubaneꞌohe. U zaꞌe e mene gubaheꞌohe.
E vazeꞌa nihe mae ḡihinoga mene umizeꞌohe. Rehano vazeꞌa nihe mae ḡihinoga urateꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe teite radiuꞌohe, ebu aniꞌe kota vazeḡa.
Rehano eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniuꞌa eḡe ḡoere hegotine, aniꞌe mene hune rudaꞌuma.”
Iuda azaḡa boroboroꞌa niro, “Izidi eme edereha, ḡaꞌe vine sauꞌaḡota! Aberahamo zu peroveta azaḡa zuni rudaro, rehano ḡa raenaꞌa, 'Iniu eḡe ḡoere hegoteꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe mene hune rudaꞌuma,' rae raꞌohe.
Ḡaꞌe emeḡe vouḡa Aberahamo ufeta vitinogahe? Aniꞌe rudaro ebu peroveta azaḡa zuni rudaro. Ḡa ḡaeꞌa bare iniu rae zamareꞌohe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “E eḡeꞌa bare nihe mae ḡihinine, aꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa. Nihe mae ḡihineꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe Mama. Aniꞌe zaeꞌa zae Badiꞌa rae huneꞌohe.
Zaꞌe ani aḡuꞌa, u eꞌe ani edeḡa. E ani aḡuꞌa rae reifone, e zae teige ḡuriro vazeḡa reifo. Rehano e ani edeḡa zu ani ḡoere hegoteꞌohe.
Zae vouḡa Aberahamoꞌe e raha ꞌada areꞌeteꞌe madaḡa horoniꞌuma rae zamaradu matuꞌe rudaro. Ebu aniꞌe eꞌe madaḡa horonadu matuꞌiro.”
Iuda azaḡa boroboroꞌa niro, “Ḡa muriḡo 50 ꞌize mene maha. Nougenouge hena Aberahamo horoniro?”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, Aberahamoꞌe ꞌizema fureranogano, eꞌe radiro.”
Eꞌebone ze hadi mae ḡihinadu Iesu mau runihi reiro. Rehano ani kuru neḡa habaꞌanonoꞌo ꞌuꞌuru buanadu dauḡiro.
